svg.metadata: {"id": "s052", "name": "美术教室", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["美术", "绘画", "色彩", "艺术"], "desc": "明亮的美术教室：墙上大幅十二色相环，两侧画架（向日葵静物与风景画），石膏几何体、颜料罐与画笔，晾画绳上挂着孩子们的作品。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "color_wheel", "enter": "zoom", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "drying_line", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "still_life", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "easel_left", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "easel_right", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "paints", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "palette", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sparkle", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#F1EAF7", "wall2": "#E2D6EF", "dado": "#C9B6E2", "floor1": "#E8CDA6", "floor2": "#D2B086", "wood": "#C98F5A", "wood2": "#A06B3E", "canvas": "#FFFDF6", "sky": "#BFE6F7", "sun": "#FFD36E", "hill": "#8ED081", "hill2": "#5FB7B0", "vase": "#5FA3D9", "petal": "#F7C13E", "petal2": "#F28C3A", "stem": "#5BA86A", "plaster": "#FBF7F2", "plaster2": "#E3DCD3", "plaster3": "#CFC6BB", "jar": "#E8F5FA", "brush": "#E8B26A", "ink": "#3B3550", "p1": "#F2584A", "p2": "#F7A23E", "p3": "#F7D648", "p4": "#7CC67A", "p5": "#4FB3D9", "p6": "#5B74D6", "p7": "#9B6CD3", "p8": "#E86BA6", "win1": "#9BD7F5", "win2": "#E3F5FF", "string": "#9C8AB8"}}
